mandatoryCriteria: Undo is a new authorized versioned move restoring the original neighboring gap, including same-column reorder and original source with other cards; never blindly supplies null/null into a nonempty column.
Persist source neighbor identities before rank compaction. Refuse changed/unavailable original gap or legacy facts lacking safe placement with409; no inferred overwrite of intervening card changes.
One normal move can be undone once; a second fresh undo cannot toggle it back. Same-key lost-response replay returns the original minimal versioned outcome after current authorization.

Ordinary moves validate actual adjacent/first/last neighbors with bounded indexed SQL reads, rather than loading all destination cards. Rare rank compaction is one set-based SQL update and never a JS row loop.

Both card/board OCC, board lifecycle/grants, receipt/activity/state atomicity and safe errors remain intact. Real mounted PostgreSQL regression/negative/receipt/concurrency tests and final independent review required.
